tagline: Turn off your PC at the time you choose
brief: A small, native-feeling Windows 11 utility that shuts the PC down at a clock time. It may grow into a suite of single-purpose utilities (like PowerToys), so the mark must also work as a system: every future tool is a key with its own glyph and hue.
criteria: Success: reads as power + time without a label, holds at 16 px in the taskbar, passes 3:1 on light and dark themes, and extends to a family of tool icons.

concepts.name: Keycap
concepts.idea: Every utility is a key you press once; this key's glyph is a power symbol read as a clock at 3:00.
rationale: Literal metaphor, as Microsoft's app-icon guidance asks: power + time, no letters
Suite-ready: future tools share the key and white glyph, each with its own hue
Pixel-fitted 16 px cut for the taskbar and title bar; face passes 3:1 on both themes
Selawik Semibold wordmark (OFL, Microsoft's open Segoe UI companion), outlined

recommendation: Keycap: a family system from day one, with a literal, legible Shutdown Timer key.
next_steps: Use shutdown-timer.ico for the app (already wired in)
Give each future tool its own key: same shape, white glyph, a hue from the contrast band
Design the suite key once the suite has a name
